description: A coalition of EU national labs and public AI institutes, leveraging partial compute from the completed InvestAI Gigafactories, launches the first sovereignly trained model at capability level 59.0 — narrowly surpassing openweight_capability. Though not yet competitive with the closed frontier, it enables restricted public-sector deployment without external dependencies. The launch is hailed as a symbolic breakthrough but strained by limited scale and integration bottlenecks due to U.S. chip restrictions.
